entities.name: Diantha
entities.description: A human acolyte from Theros in the service of the Oracle of Kruphix.

entities.name: Kydele
entities.description: Six-armed Oracle of Kruphix, once rescued by her god from Xenagos.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons whose small temple in Meletis Diantha serves.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City with a small temple of Kruphix.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Held Kydele in his grip before Kruphix rescued her.

entities.name: Temple of Kruphix at the edge of the world
entities.description: Temple where Kydele spent time after being rescued.

events.summary: Diantha brings the oracle Kydele her meal.
events.quote: Diantha set down the tray of mutton and grilled vegetables, fresh olives, and cheese.

events.summary: Kydele mentions her time at the temple of Kruphix at the edge of the world after her god rescued her from Xenagos.
events.quote: after her god rescued her from the grip of Xenagos

events.summary: Diantha confesses she envies Kydele and cannot hear Kruphix's voice, and asks for any insight.
events.quote: she told Kydele she envied her

events.summary: After a long silence Kydele says there is nothing she can share, and Diantha leaves.
events.quote: there was nothing at all she could share

relations.note: acolyte in the Oracle of Kruphix's service
relations.quote: Diantha was in the Oracle of Kruphix 's service
after her god rescued her from the grip of Xenagos
